one_line: Kakatiya king of Warangal defending his diamond-rich Deccan fortress against Alauddin Khalji’s siege.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, athletic and wiry, with a disciplined warrior’s build.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, straight nose, medium-brown Deccan complexion; intense almond-shaped eyes, a neatly trimmed mustache, short beard along the jawline, and a calm, resolute default expression.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair pulled back into a short, tidy warrior’s topknot at the crown; the front smoothed back; simple gold circlet resting above the forehead, with a small central ruby-like red stone.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate Kakatiya royal warrior attire: a fitted quilted cotton angarakha-style tunic in deep maroon with subtle block-printed floral motifs in darker red, reaching mid-thigh and belted with a broad golden-yellow fabric sash; over it a sleeveless, slightly curved steel chest-plate and matching armguards with minimal incised detailing; lower body in cream-coloured, slightly loose churidar-style trousers; feet in brown leather sandals with simple straps; a long, draped shoulder cloth (uttariya) of rich indigo cotton with a thin gold border runs from left shoulder across the back and around the right forearm; modest gold earrings, a single gold armlet on the right biceps, and a red tilak mark on the forehead.
appearance.signature: A finely crafted, slightly curved South Indian steel sword with a distinctive disc-pommel and flared guard, sheathed in a dark brown leather scabbard with simple brass fittings, carried at his left hip and often held drawn in his right hand.

ref_desc: Prataparudra II is a mid-30s, medium-brown Kakatiya king with a warrior’s topknot, gold circlet, maroon quilted tunic, indigo shoulder cloth, cream trousers, steel chest-plate and armguards, disc-pommel sword at his hip, accented in golden yellow and steel grey.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Prataparudra II: a mid-30s Kakatiya king with an athletic build, oval medium-brown face, intense almond eyes, neat mustache and short jawline beard, and calm resolute expression. His thick black hair is pulled into a short warrior’s topknot, smoothed back at the front, crowned by a simple gold circlet with a small central red stone and a red tilak on the forehead. He wears an era-accurate deep maroon quilted cotton angarakha-style tunic with subtle darker-red floral patterns, belted by a broad golden-yellow sash at the waist, over which sits a sleeveless steel chest-plate and matching steel armguards. A long indigo cotton shoulder cloth with a thin gold border drapes from his left shoulder across his back and around his right forearm. His lower body is covered in cream churidar-style trousers and brown leather sandals. Show modest gold earrings and a single gold armlet on his right biceps. At his left hip is his signature slightly curved South Indian steel sword with disc-pommel and flared guard in a dark brown leather scabbard with brass fittings; in at least one pose, have him holding the drawn sword with confident readiness. Use a palette of deep maroon, indigo blue, cream, golden yellow, and steel grey so the character can be consistently recognized across panels.
